standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-count-embeddings (delivered card L48377): Mor_F(K, overline{F}) bijects with the set of compatible root tuples (beta_1..beta_n)

Chapter lemma-nr-roots-unchanged (source lemma): the number of roots of a polynomial is unchanged under pushforward of the coefficients by a coefficient-field homomorphism, so P_i and P_i^{phi_{i-1}} have equally many roots

Well-definedness of the separable degree of an irreducible polynomial (observed just prior to definition-separable-degree, source lines 1480-1483): deg_s(P_i) = number of roots in any algebraic closure
core_obligations: By the bijection, |Mor_F(K, overline{F})| equals the number of compatible tuples; the beta_i available at step i are exactly the roots of P_i^{phi_{i-1}} determined by the earlier choices, independently of them in number
By root-count invariance under conjugation, that number is the separable degree deg_s(P_i) for every step, giving the product formula
proof_roadmap: Count the tuples step by step through the embedding bijection
Convert each per-step root count into a separable degree
